bio.text: Cliff Bentz was elected on November 3, 2020, to represent Oregon's 2nd Congressional District in the U.S. House.
He served in the Oregon House of Representatives from 2008 to 2018 and in the Oregon State Senate until January 2, 2020.
A third-generation Oregonian raised in Harney County, he holds a law degree from Lewis and Clark Law School and practiced law in Ontario, Oregon, from 1977.
